Actually I think we're still seeing this on machines with low memory (I have 8GB)
Is this still happening? Can you paste in a stack trace so we can tell where the recursion pain points are?
I don't think so. But I mostly use ruby 1.9.2 with sass these days -- might be reproducible in other rubys with small heaps.

Ran into this issue with a generated sass file (output by railsjedi's Sprite gem).  His file generates a long @if/@else file; with a lot of sprites, the syntax tree is extremely deep and Ruby bombs out when trying to marshal the tree.

Been having this same issue, however on two different issues.  First it was while running ruby 1.9.3 head.  I stepped back to 1.9.2 and it calmed down, however with 1.9.2 I have seen some issues where simply adding height changes to a footer evoke the error.
I'd like to see a stack trace and example file for this error.

here is the example:

```
@import "compass";
@import "flags-iso/a16/*.png";
```
